items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Native form on Base UI Form with consolidated errors: server errors keyed by Field name, first invalid field focused on submit.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Built on Base UI; ornaments are drawn with CSS only. `onFormSubmit` may return a Promise: data-pending + aria-busy on the form, FormSubmit shows loading, submits while pending are ignored, a resolved or rejected `{ name: message }` map is shown under the fields and focuses the first invalid control. Rejected by design: dirtyGuard (router/app concern), reset-with-undo.
